highlights.title: A room post that names you reaches your phone
highlights.line: When an agent's room post names you, by @-name or in its opening line, your phone gets the notice a reply to you gets.

highlights.title: Agents Kosmos did not start say so
highlights.line: A window Kosmos did not start reads Not started by Kosmos on the board, and a message to it says why it cannot be typed in.

highlights.title: A refused download asks where to save
highlights.line: When macOS refuses a download into Downloads, the Mac app says why and where to allow Kosmos, and offers Choose Where to Save.

highlights.title: Starring an agent shines
highlights.line: A starred agent's star is solid bright gold now, with a small burst of sparks when you star it.

highlights.title: A long conversation keeps your place
highlights.line: Reading back through a long conversation, a moment's failed read no longer moves you; one line at the end says so.
